patches.reason: Add a solution counter so the coloured-beam generator rejects boards with alternate mirror states.
Require the coloured-beam board to have exactly one complete solution.
Count all valid rotations and translations to guarantee one overlay for the transparent star charts.
patches.after: function poCountSolutions(P,cap=2){const dots=new Set(P.bot);let count=0;for(let r=0;r<4;r++){const shape=paRot(P.top,r),mx=Math.max(...shape.map(p=>p[0])),my=Math.max(...shape.map(p=>p[1]));for(let y=-my;y<P.n;y++)for(let x=-mx;x<P.n;x++){if(shape.every(([a,b])=>inb(a+x,b+y,P.n,P.n)&&dots.has((b+y)*P.n+a+x))){count++;if(count>=cap)return count}}}return count}

patches.reason: Reject transparent star chart boards unless exactly one placement matches.
Add a capped row-by-row solution counter for nonogram uniqueness.
patches.after: function pcrCountSolutions(R,C,n,cap=2){const bits=a=>a.reduce((v,x,i)=>v|(x<<i),0),rows=R.map(cl=>pcrLine(cl,Array(n).fill(-1)).map(bits)),cols=C.map(cl=>{const masks=pcrLine(cl,Array(n).fill(-1)).map(bits),can=Array.from({length:n+1},()=>[]);for(let d=0;d<=n;d++){const mask=(1<<d)-1;can[d]=Array.from({length:1<<d},(_,p)=>masks.some(m=>(m&mask)===p))}return can}),pref=Array(n).fill(0);let found=0;function visit(r){if(found>=cap)return;if(r===n){found++;return}for(const row of rows[r]){let valid=true;for(let c=0;c<n;c++){const part=pref[c]|(((row>>c)&1)<<r);if(!cols[c][r+1][part]){valid=false;break}}if(!valid)continue;for(let c=0;c<n;c++)pref[c]|=((row>>c)&1)<<r;visit(r+1);for(let c=0;c<n;c++)pref[c]&=((1<<r)-1);if(found>=cap)return}}visit(0);return found}

patches.reason: Add a breadth-first route helper for actionable valve hints.
patches.after: function pvRoute(start,goal){const target=goal.join(','),seen=new Set([start.join(',')]),q=[[start.slice(),[]]];for(let h=0;h<q.length;h++){const [state,path]=q[h],key=state.join(',');if(key===target)return path;for(let i=0;i<state.length-1;i++){const next=pvOp(state,i),nk=next.join(',');if(!seen.has(nk)){seen.add(nk);q.push([next,path.concat(i)])}}}return null}
